sentences.text: Researchers examined large tissue samples from the nasal area of 13 preserved human bodies, using chemical stains and antibody-based techniques to analyze specific cell types and the connections between different layers of the nasal lining.
To quantify these structures, a special computer program was created to measure tissue thickness and identify the distinct types of epithelium present in the samples.

The analysis revealed that the three types of nasal lining possess different cell mixes and structures, with the olfactory layer varying in thickness compared to the respiratory layer and exhibiting transitions that are more complex than those seen in small biopsies.
Consequently, these results establish a detailed map of the human nasal lining that serves as a baseline for future research on aging, disease, and smell loss.
